behaviors.description: Approve removal with closed stdin using either automatic mode.
behaviors.preconditions: Exact independent app/runtime installed before each mode.
behaviors.expected: An ordinary unapproved removal preserves both refs; automatic modes remove only the app without waiting for consent.

mappings.rationale: Ref membership before and after refusal and approval establishes actual removal and preservation of the runtime.
